what_is_happening.claim: Striding AI unveiled H1 and C1 robots for 24/7 convenience stores, targeting a service launch in 2027.
GlobalFoundries announced FDX Fusion, an FD‑SOI platform for physical AI, with production slated for 2028.
KAIST disclosed a physical AI vision, demonstrating wearable robots and announcing a strategy beyond humanoids.
South Korea is experiencing a physical AI boom, with robot baristas and K‑pop dancers appearing in public venues.
A startup led by an ex‑Nvidia GPU architect released the Y10 chip designed to close robot control loops in 1 ms.
Inner Sky Labs launched a physical AI platform and is seeking ₹300 crore in funding.
Tata Elxsi observed that physical AI is already happening but the frontier remains wide.
Retailer Tally deployed 3,000 robots, demonstrating that physical AI can generate measurable business returns.
SK Square backed Japanese physical AI startup Mujin to expand its robotics capabilities.
Lutech unveiled a humanoid robot (L.u.c.a.) for Italian factories amid forthcoming EU machinery regulations.
IIT Madras students are pursuing AI research in Japan after beginning in physical science.
Omdia identified four forces set to reshape technology in 2027, influencing physical AI development.
Barclays reported that robots are rolling out and economies are being rewired by physical AI.
